text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A season of dancing cherry blossoms.
Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho, the first leg of the Triple Tiara,
had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I will claim the Triple Tiara.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(And Still in Love—
this is the end of her threatening presence.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I hear you. We must watch out for any Umamusume
moving from the front group toward the front of the midfield, correct?"
choice_data_list: The top contenders are likely to be clustered there.
Looks like the top contenders will be clustered there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No problem. If there's nothing else, I'd like to focus alone... so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I met up with Air Groove at the venue. I had invited her
since she had been looking out for Admire Groove for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, huh.
Though it's a race I couldn't run in myself...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I want all the runners to run
a race they won't regret—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Naturally, to Alv as well. ...How is he doing now?
choice_data_list: She said she wanted to concentrate alone. She already left.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Or should I say, that's just so like an Álfr.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Man, I've been waiting for this day forever...! This year's gotta be Admire Groove's year!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, you never know.
I hear that Still in Love, who debuted later, is pretty strong too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Or so they say.
What are your chances of winning as a Trainer?
choice_data_list: I think we have plenty of chances to win.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Indeed, she doesn't appear to have any real weaknesses.
In terms of overall ability, she's definitely in the top tier.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, when evenly matched titans clash—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More often than not, what decides victory and defeat
is not a slight gap in ability... but one's mindset.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Alv...-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will not yield the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho, and everything beyond. I will win them all...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... see...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yet today, I too...
no matter what... desperately desire 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Even so, I have prepared tirelessly for this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To win the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To prove my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's why... I will defeat you, the obstacle in my path.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No...
Please don't say... such things...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you stand there—
all I have to do is strike you down and move forward.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I must not...
If I hear any more such tempting words—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I just can't hold back anymore!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh! This... feeling is...
just like back then after all...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu... Ahaha...
Ah-hahaha-ha-haaaa!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "By the time you reach the Tiara, please make sure you're ripe and delicious"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she kept the promise from when we ran together before?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Just being stared at like that... What intense pressure...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to taste every bit—
Let's enjoy ourselves to the fullest today...♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll sever the ties of fate between us
at the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The one who wins... is me...!
